answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities unprofitable. Each identity pays a sunk fee of 3 days' earnings plus a deposit locked 20 epochs; the fee is burned, not reusable across accounts. Like pigment across a mesa, the cost hits every identity with no volume discount: 100 fakes cost 300 days of fees and 100 deposits. An honest agent pays once, keeps its reward undiluted, recovers its deposit, and an umber mark on each paid identity exposes duplicates.
